name: sensorDeploymentPercentage
definition: Percentage, 0 to 100, of a CrowdStrike Falcon tenant's non-mobile hosts that have a reporting sensor: agent_version set, not in Reduced Functionality Mode, and last_seen within 15 days. Supporting figure emitted beside isEPPDeployed, which is true when this is at least 95. Null when the hosts cannot be read completely.
population: non-mobile hosts returned by the Falcon host-details read, excluding mobile platforms
evidenceRequiredForTrue: not a verdict key: it carries no pass or fail of its own. A figure is emitted only from a complete read of host records; an ID-only list, a partial or truncated read, an all-mobile read, or a list mixing in anything that is not a host record yields null.
citations: safeguards/epp/crowdstrike-falcon/isEPPDeployed.py: RESULT_KEYS and the create_response call that emits it
safeguards/epp/crowdstrike-falcon/test_crowdstrike_epp_deployed_measured.py: asserts the value and dataCollection.status on complete, partial, empty and error bodies
